content.title: Saudi Deputy Minister for Health visits Aga Khan University
content.summary: Dr Obeid Suleman Al-Obeid, Saudi Deputy Minister for Health, being shown the Bio-Safety Level II laboratory at Juma Building, by Zulfiqar Naqvi, a senior research officer at AKU.

media.alt: Saudi Deputy Minister for Health visits Aga Khan University

content.text: Dr Obeid Suleman Al-Obeid, Saudi Deputy Minister for Health, being shown the Bio-Safety Level II laboratory at Juma Building, by Zulfiqar Naqvi, a senior research officer at AKU. With state-of-the-art equipment, and the sophisticated Bio-Safety Level III laboratory, the Juma Building is the first of its type of research facility in Pakistan. This facility promotes research and attracts research-oriented faculty to the University. Dr Ashfaq Ahmed, Deputy Director General Health, Ministry of Health, Islamabad, accompanied the Saudi Minister of Healthi.

Dr Obeid Suleman Al-Obeid, Saudi Deputy Minister for Health, being shown the Bio-Safety Level II laboratory at Juma Building, by Zulfiqar Naqvi, a senior research officer at AKU. With state-of-the-art equipment, and the sophisticated Bio-Safety Level III laboratory, the Juma Building is the first of its type of research facility in Pakistan. This facility promotes research and attracts research-oriented faculty to the University. Dr Ashfaq Ahmed, Deputy Director General Health, Ministry of Health, Islamabad, accompanied the Saudi Minister of Healthi.

During his visit to AKU, Dr Obeid Suleman Al-Obeid, Saudi Deputy Minister for Health, is interacting with students at the Multidisciplinary Laboratory at the University's Medical College. Dr Obeid Suleman took keen interest in the facility and exchanged ideas on various areas of mutual interest.
